## Design and planning

[NICE Project Builder](nice-design-tool.qmd)  
Document the situation, needs and necessities, inquiry, prototypes, feedback, and evaluation for a design project. The builder creates a project document that can be downloaded as Markdown or Word, or saved as PDF through the browser.

- design and measurement
- electronics and digital logic
- programming and data
- fabrication
- transportation and automotive work
